title: Riverside Clinic check-in
description: App Store screenshot meeting: Kestrel Labs prepares the version two beta. Turns are scheduled back to back from measured Kokoro durations. The first 14 s are silent so the recording, started once the call is live, catches every line.

turns.speaker: leo
turns.text: Hi Ruth, thanks for making time. Amara from our product team is here too.

turns.speaker: ruth
turns.text: Hello both. I'll be honest, the main thing on our side is still offline mode. Our community clinics lose signal all the time.

turns.speaker: amara
turns.text: That's exactly what we want to talk about. The beta of version two ships on the third of November, and it includes offline mode for reading the schedule.

turns.speaker: ruth
turns.text: So staff can see the day's appointments without signal?

turns.speaker: amara
turns.text: Yes. The schedule is saved on the device, with a clear banner showing when it was last updated.

turns.speaker: ruth
turns.text: That covers most of our mornings. What about booking or moving appointments offline?

turns.speaker: leo
turns.text: That's coming in the release after. We want to get conflict handling right before anyone edits offline.

turns.speaker: ruth
turns.text: That's fair. I'd rather wait than have two nurses book the same slot.

turns.speaker: ruth
turns.text: One more thing. Our data protection officer wants an export of all appointment data, for the annual audit.

turns.speaker: leo
turns.text: We can do a full export today from the admin page. I'll send you the steps by Friday.

turns.speaker: ruth
turns.text: Lovely. And could two of our clinics join the beta?

turns.speaker: amara
turns.text: Absolutely. Leo will set up beta access for both clinics before the third of November.
